description: What's new in the lists this person has access to since a point in time. Defaults to the last 7 days. Pass the returned `checkedAt` back as `since` next time for a gap-free diff.

limit.description: Max new picks, 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to 7 days ago.
